accessibility.description: VoiceOver reads the board and re-announces it after every slide, and hazards are named rather than shown by colour alone. Move with a three-finger swipe or the Actions rotor, explore the board by touch, and use Magic Tap to read the board. Each tile has a sound panned by column, and a Field Manual explains the game. TalkBack support has had little testing. Full-screen ads can interrupt play; the developer can disable them for screen reader users on request.
